pins.definition: To hold or transport something or someone from one place to another.
To hold and move something from one place to another.
To hold something and take it somewhere on foot.

situation: A weary porter trudges up a steep, dusty mountain path with a heavy wooden crate balanced on his shoulder.
subject: the physical transport of a heavy load on foot
brief: An exhausted man in a coarse tunic walks steadily up an incline, one hand gripping the heavy wooden crate resting squarely on his shoulder. Dust kicks up around his boots, and the strained muscles of his neck and arm clearly show the heavy burden he is moving across the frame.
